request.style: English, sweet children's song, kind female lead vocal with children's choir, ukulele, acoustic guitar, glockenspiel, soft hand claps, warm and sing-along, 108 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Mothers and fathers came along
Bringing children, small and young
Babies, sisters, brothers too
Jesus, we have come to you
But the disciples said go away
He's too busy here today
Jesus saw it and he said
Bring them here to me instead

[Chorus]
Let the little children come to me
Do not hinder them
For the kingdom of God belongs to such as these
Let the little children come

[Verse]
Arms wide open, here I come
Jesus loves me, everyone
Big or small or short or tall
Jesus has a hug for all
He took them in his arms
Laid his hands on them
And blessed them

[Chorus]
Let the little children come to me
Do not hinder them
For the kingdom of God belongs to such as these
Let the little children come

[Bridge]
Hands up high and hands down low
Jesus wants us all to know
Whoever does not receive the kingdom of God like a little child
Will never enter it

[Chorus]
Let the little children come to me
Do not hinder them
For the kingdom of God belongs to such as these
Let the little children come
